initialFocus.scope: Only test wording for the existing missing service description notice differed; corrected assertion, production unchanged.

limits: Complete bounded negative clinical requests, no general medical NLP or symptom triage.
No inferred vaccine eligibility, treatment benefit, clinical clearance, first-visit procedure guarantee or default appointment selection.
Approved urgent response stays authoritative; missing, expired and foreign scripts use existing fallback.
Active clinical reports use private Cliniko message proof and separate explicit send.
No new patient authority, native operation, durable patient field, dependency or configuration change.
Synthetic signed speech/provider/mail/approval only; no live activation, real delivery or new real-model pass.
